If you're going to San Francsico... We are losing people to the south. On their way are Annie, Tammy Smith, Jerri, and the Little Magnets (Paul Hood, Dame Dimitri, Lee Lumsden). Farewell...
Is it true Time Travelers is looking to open a club/theater in Pioneer Square?? Cellophane Square will be producing a show May 25th at Washington Hall...... Featuring The Cheaters and The Radios.
Suprise band gigging in Seattle lately: The Fishsticks. Who says bubblegum rock is dead??
Expect an extravaganza! The Dead Kennedy's will be here July 13 & 14. Brought to you by Time Travelers
The first new wave band to come out from the wilds of Bellingham is called The Accident.

News from the Readymades..... They are only two to three weeks away from a recording contract, says bassist Wayne Deitzel. The band has some gigs lined up, including opening for Tom Robinson, and playing second bill to Roxy Music. The band is still working with Sandy Pearlman, and may be signed by one of the following labels: Warner Bros., Electra, Mercury, and get this: RSO. Watch out Bee Gees!!
If you dont already know, The Mentors are dead. Rumor has it that Eldon is in LA to form a new band. Son of Mentor????

Rock against Racism chapters are forming around the USA. Concerts are being planed. If youre interested, contact them in Ny at: PO Box 392, Canal St. Sta. NYC 10013 (212) 553-5028 The Cheaters have a new drummer: James Gascoigne.........
Vinyl out from Ian Fisher soon. A-side has an ex-Telepath back up, and B-side has an ex-Invader backup. Noy bad.....

The Moderley's continue to gig around town, getting a great share of local newspaper publicity. So how come most people don't like them. Do Patrick and George known something the rest of us don't?? Maybe it's all in knowing the right people....
Ex-Generator (and ex-e member) Mitchael Wonderful is the new Enemy bass player.. George returns to rhythm.
Be on the lookout for a great new single for Ice 9. Featured are: "Out, Out, Out", "Revolting Mess", and "27.3". It's gonna be great!!
The next show: May 19 8PM at Washington Hall (14th and Fir), featuring: The Dils DOA and Chinas Comidas. A Robert Benne- tt/Wes (second Time Round) Production.
Greg Scars has left the Avengers to form a new band. His replacement is Brad Kunt (ex-DOA).
Are Time Travelers bringing the Screamers to Seattle? Is Roger Husbands? Who will win?
Gina and Gary (ex-Generator) were recen- tly married in a Canadian extravaganza.. We at STELLAZINE send them a mint copy of "Gimme Money"......
Look for the new Offs single on Walking Dead Productions. "Jonny Too Bad" b/w "624803". Soon back from a stint in NY.
New Avengers single produced by ex-Pistol Steve Jones includes "White ******". Are they on their way to an English record company contract?????
And finally, Seattle will be back on the concert path in about a month. The cir- cuit will be Portland, Seattle and Vanc- ouver....We can't wait!!!!
The X-Men have disbanded. Gregor and Glen are writing music together. Dickle fever will engulf Seattle in a couple of months when they return from a European tour.....
Engineer Harry Cool has formed a record label for the area. First band to sign: Ice 9. Look for possible vinyl fom some Seattle bands...... The name? Vynyl Re- cords......
Ex-Clones Jeff and Sheldon are in SF to form a new band.
Radio news: Kim has not been kicked out. Allan will do vocals, and a new guitar- ist has been added. Look for a possible gig in May with the Cheaters, produced by Cellophane Square.....
Randy Pandora (ex-Generator) has a new band: The Detectives
New on the concert promotion scene: Time Travelers and Cellophane Square.
